I had the pleasure of staying with Andy and his family at this beautiful place in Thailand, and it was such a special experience. The location is incredibly peaceful and tranquil, away from the busy tourist areas, which allows you to truly slow down, reconnect with nature, and experience a more authentic side of local life.

From the moment I arrived, I felt genuinely welcomed and cared for by Andy and his family. Their kindness and hospitality made me feel at home straight away. My stay at Garuda Wellness Center was truly exceptional. From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed, cared for, and completely at ease. The setting is peaceful and beautiful, creating the perfect environment to disconnect from the stresses of everyday life and reconnect with yourself.
What impressed me most was the genuine attention to detail and the sincere care shown by the team. Everything felt thoughtfully designed to support relaxation, wellbeing, and personal growth. The atmosphere is warm, authentic, and free from the commercial feel that many wellness retreats have.
The accommodation, food, and activities all exceeded my expectations. Whether you're looking to deepen your wellness practice, find some inner peace, or simply spend time in a nurturing environment surrounded by nature, this is a place that delivers far more than it promises.
I left feeling refreshed, inspired, and grateful for the experience. Garuda Wellness Center is a special place, and I would highly recommend it to anyone seeking a meaningful and transformative retreat in Thailand.
